{{Quote|This is the latest hit from Danny and the Droids. It's called 'I Wanna Weld Your Hand.' I love those roboto intros.|G2-9T|<ref name="Star Tours" />}}
"'''I Wanna Weld Your Hand'''" was a hit song recorded by the musical group [[Danny and the Droids]]. It had a [[roboto]] intro and was a favorite of the [[Maintenance droid/Legends|repair droid]] [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]], who sometimes listened to the song on the station [[K-DROID]].<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
This song, heard in the background of the [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride queue, makes up the first half of the instrumental track titled "[[The Droid Rooms]]," released on ''The Music of Disneyland, Walt Disney World and Epcot Center'' ([[1988]])<ref name="Music Of">{{WebCite|url=https://www.discogs.com/master/543286-Various-The-Music-Of-Disneyland-Walt-Disney-World-And-Epcot-Center|text=''The Music of Disneyland, Walt Disney World and Epcot Center''|work=Discogs.com|archivedate=20211206183906}}</ref>, ''The Official Album of Disneyland and Walt Disney World'' ([[1991]])<ref name="Official Album">{{WebCite|url=https://www.discogs.com/release/4463231-Various-The-Official-Album-Of-Disneyland-And-Walt-Disney-World|text=''The Official Album Of Disneyland And Walt Disney World''|work=Discogs.com|archivedate=20211206183553}}</ref> and ''Tokyo Disneyland Music Album'' ([[2001]]).<ref name="Tokyo DL">{{WebCite|url=https://www.discogs.com/release/15513326-Tokyo-Disneyland-Tokyo-Disneyland-Music-Album|text=''Tokyo Disneyland Music Album''|work=Discogs.com|archivedate=20230117094610}}</ref>. Its title is a reference to [[Wikipedia:The Beatles|The Beatles]]' song "[[Wikipedia:I Want to Hold Your Hand|I Want to Hold Your Hand]]," and was composed by [[Richard Bellis]].<ref name="Bellis">{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours/creating-star-tours/2008/09/interview-richard-bellis|text=Interview - Richard Bellis}}</ref>
